title: Asset and Cover
author: Ines Joubert
blurb: Paloma Pemberton, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
